title: React Admin — schematic amortization
stack: React 19 · Vite · TypeScript · Tailwind v4 + shadcn · TanStack Router/Query · MSW v2 · Playwright + axe
about: Frontend admin CRUD over 14 entities in three difficulty tiers (vanilla, real-world quirks, heavy workflows), built in 5 clean-room batches with no memory between sessions. NEITHER arm starts with a schematic: the with-schematics arm must AUTHOR its own Project Builder generator during batch 1 and reuse it afterwards; the without arm hand-writes every module following the same reference implementation.
proves: Amortization — the claim workbench 01 could not test because its generator pre-existed. Batch 1 should cost the with-schematics arm MORE (it pays the authoring investment); every later batch should cost near-zero marginal, crossing the manual arm's cumulative cost at a visible break-even batch — while generated modules stay structurally identical and hand-written ones drift.

experiments.title: Schematic amortization · Sonnet 5
experiments.hypothesis: Authoring a schematic in batch 1 costs more up front, but later batches cost so little that the with-schematics arm ends batch 5 below the manual arm's cumulative cost, at the same quality.
experiments.variable: The with-schematics arm must author its own Project Builder schematic in batch 1 and reuse it afterwards; the other arm hand-writes every module.
constants: Same base app, 14 entities, tiers and batch schedule
One fresh clean-room session per batch and arm
Same definition of done per batch
